description: Defines the implementation of a multi-executor downlink processor class for handling PDUs and resource grid processing in a wireless communication system, including threading, task execution, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: downlink_processor_multi_executor_impl
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe downlink processor managing multiple executors for different PDU types, handling resource grid configuration, processing, and completion callbacks.

classes.name: downlink_processor_callback
classes.description: Interface for callback when a downlink processing task is completed.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_notifier_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps PDSCH processing notifications to trigger task completion callbacks.

classes.name: downlink_task_executor
classes.description: Wrapper around task_executor to enforce non-allocating task deferral.

classes.name: pdsch_proc_args
classes.description: Holds arguments for PDSCH processing including PDU and associated data.

methods.name: configure_resource_grid
methods.description: Configures the resource grid with provided context and grid, preparing for PDU processing.

methods.name: process_pdsch
methods.description: Processes PDSCH PDUs with associated data.

methods.name: finish_processing_pdus
methods.description: Finalizes PDU processing and triggers resource grid transmission.

methods.name: send_resource_grid
methods.description: Sends the configured resource grid through the gateway.

methods.name: on_task_completion
methods.description: Handles completion of a processing task, updating internal state and possibly triggering grid transmission.
